_purpose: Reels that must never be reposted, as judged by a human. The scorer hard-excludes these.
_why_this_lives_in_git: posts.db is gitignored and gets rebuilt by backfill.py. This is irreplaceable human judgment, so it is versioned, travels with the repo, and survives any database rebuild.

_reasons.event_promo: The video itself was made to promote a dated event. Reposting tells people a gig is happening that already happened - someone could turn up at a venue on the wrong night. Never repost, regardless of how it scores.
_reasons.dated_claim: Makes a time-bound claim that would be false today (a release, a collaboration announcement, a milestone).
_reasons.rights: Music, footage or a collaborator's likeness that cannot be re-published.
_reasons.retired: Superseded, or no longer represents the player.

excluded.note: Frau Mayer Latin Dance Party, 23 May 20:15. Date and venue are the content.
"Playing tomorrow at @miles.smiles.vienna, see you there". Made to fill a room on a specific night.
